candidate_source.status: Exact combined source commit, complete CI and independent review are not yet available. Bind them in a separate immutable source file before any attempt claim.

source_freeze_contract.policy: Exact complete18-file source inventory,17 correctness modules, immutable historical O .txt witness, successful nine-job combined-source CI and independent whole-NO review references must be committed and verified before attempt claim. Source combines only N's normalization-run substitution and corrected O's whole-string lexical certificate on exact LM. Both complete donor inverse proofs and the retained unfixed STOP-mutation witness must pass. Missing source binding fails before evidence fetch, claim, download or retrieval.

derivation.policy: Retain the proven LM separate correctness and measurement exports, complete source/archive guards, and every original statistical/count/payload/data/helper/ABBA function. Change only candidate/source/attempt/evidence identities; append the two exact NO correctness modules, a separately exact frozen support-file inventory checked before and after correctness, and preclaim evidence validation for the preserved LM below-target result. Add focused negative artificial fixtures for missing, modified or substituted O witness bytes. Keep all historical LM/K/J drivers, scopes and results unchanged.

prior_evidence: Retain complete J rejection (eight adverse cells), K below-target result (zero adverse cells; GM p95 improvement3.6355909620451876%) and LM below-target result (zero cells over5% adverse; GM p95 improvement4.791840281283378%; public native char4000 improvement5.430823483528835%). LM's public token512 p95 worsened3.7551366648520768% and its other observed regressions remain present. NO is measured directly against released v032; N/O have no component corpus timings. Never pool host timings, add component percentages, rerun unfavorable attempts or relabel below-target evidence as acceptance.

correctness.criterion: Every fixture in the exact17 registered modules must run once with zero skips/failures/errors. All15 historical LM modules remain byte-identical. The two new donor modules may change only the prospectively registered counterpart-source hashes/descriptive labels; preserve every behavioral assertion and native mechanism proof. Verify the separately bound immutable O historical witness before and after the suite. No hardcoded fixture count conceals omission.
correctness.environment: One ubuntu-24.04 / Python3.12 hosted VM; same pinned mcp1.30.0, pydantic2.14.3, tiktoken0.12.0 and regex2026.11.9 for both runtimes. Capture actual Python/SQLite/dependency/binary/tokenizer-cache identities before measurement.
correctness.isolation: First export exact frozen NO src/tests into a dedicated correctness directory. Verify every runtime/module/support-file hash and runtime aggregate, save started intent, then run the registered17-module suite once. Retain every file afterward, capture complete added/missing/changed inventory and archive losslessly. Missing/changed bound files or unknown added Python/non-bytecode files fail before measurement. Generated bytecode is explicitly recorded only in this never-measured directory; never delete it or exclude it from a measurement guard.
correctness.measurement_export: After correctness and its saved inventory audit pass, independently export fresh exact baseline692fb and the frozen NO candidate src/tests into separate measurement directories. Recheck the complete file inventory, no symlinks and aggregate runtime SHA before profile and every paired stage. An extra pyc or unknown .py in either measurement export fails the complete guard. Never import or execute measurement helpers from the correctness export.
correctness.archive: Commit correctness-export.tar.gz and its full manifest/hash before corpus preparation. It contains only the repository source/tests and artificial fixture residue, never a downloaded development corpus or development DB. Preserve negative receipts and available partial files without retries.

data.policy: Only previously used old regression cohorts and exactly registered selections/seeds. No fresh selector, model, comparison engine or evaluator is invoked.

profile.method: Read only the nine exact small manifest/cell objects through git show; validate every compressed size/SHA256 and decompressed SHA256. Run one fresh candidate profile using the unchanged helper. Preserve original report bytes losslessly as gzip with raw and compressed hashes. Verify all eight cell axes, complete orders, dataset hashes and all 4732 full non-timing payload digests against saved v032/C2 references. Publish output and audit before paired timing; any incomplete profile or mismatch stops the paired phase.
profile.preservation: All instrumented profiler rows and negative outcomes remain present. Summary profile times identify code paths only; no historical profile latency or profiler time is used to infer speed.

snapshots: Before profile/timing, build each new paired source database exactly once with released v032 and the frozen old loader. Record immutable DB bytes, sizes, logical table digests and query selection. Both runtimes copy those same snapshots to unique worker directories; the profile helper independently creates its own candidate databases, exactly as before. No historical database hash is substituted, no completed worker DB is reused. Controller allocation during snapshot hashing is not a formal memory-resource measurement.

paired.query_selection: Same 128 old IDs per cohort; independently recompute selection and require equality with the frozen original binding.
paired.query_order: random.Random(91261 + round*1009 + configuration_index).shuffle; original AB/BA order.
paired.audit: All eight workers, 4096 observations, 2048 full non-timing payload pairs, exact query/configuration order, finite timings, per-round and pooled p50/p95/mean, p95 geometric change, and every cell whose p50 or p95 regresses beyond5%. No selection of favorable repetitions.

durability.policy: Only run_attempt1 on the exact new trigger; reject existing result/state. Before claim verify frozen NO source/support binding, exact inherited LM driver, complete successful combined-source CI, independent NO review and all preserved J/K/LM decisions. Preserve correctness intent/outcome/archive, fresh measurement source inventories, new DB binding, profile intent/output/audit and every paired-worker intent/result in verified remote commits. No automatic measurement or publication retry.
durability.publication: Non-force expected-head verification. After one push verify exact new remote commit. On refusal or ambiguity, stop without automatic retry; retain failure marker and artifacts. No source database or corpus plaintext is published.
durability.failure: Keep all original receipts, failed/incomplete stages, available cell-granularity partial JSON and logs. Gzip conversion is lossless with exact uncompressed checksum. Workflow always preservation never invokes retrieval or replays a stage.

formal_and_release: No original numerical threshold is changed: the14-cell/66248-call formal performance requirements, full-payload contracts, resource review, historical lexical/Q2 compatibility, planned fresh quality validation and release verification remain separate mandatory steps. This development run alone cannot certify release readiness or competitor superiority.
authoring_policy: Commit this prospective scope before the new controller. Staging may run artificial protocol CI only. The draft has no candidate source binding and cannot claim an experiment. After donor gates and complete combined-source CI/review, freeze exact source/test/support/evidence identity in the separate source binding, update only explicit draft binding/source constants, and review a successful final artificial CI. Only root may create the unique measurement trigger. The final launch-ready commit must not contain a skip-ci directive.
